title: Leetflex Banned Accounts
summary: Return accounts that have two sessions which overlap in time and were made from different IP addresses.
inputFormat: LogInfo(account_id, ip_address, login, logout) with session timestamps.
outputFormat: Distinct account_id values, one per banned account.
edgeRules: Sessions from the same IP address do not count. Whether sessions that only touch at an endpoint overlap is not settled in the draft.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: account 1 sessions 10-20 (IP a) and 15-25 (IP b) -> banned; sessions 10-20 and 20-30 with different IPs -> depends on inclusive rule.
